tools.name: The Dashboard
tools.line: A live dashboard over a database that lives in your browser tab. Pick the size, click any chart, and every panel re-queries it while the page times each query on your own device.

tools.name: The Helix
tools.line: Paste DNA sequences and a column of measurements and see the double helix in the numbers: a score graded in your browser, with the controls that would expose a false win shown beside it.

tools.name: The Analyst
tools.line: Paste any data and profile it with a real SQL database in your browser: types, distributions, anomalies and hidden entities, then query it at a live SQL prompt.

tools.name: The Creature
tools.line: Raise a creature that learns to navigate a world you draw. A holographic transformer is its brain and the pathfinder is its feet.

tools.name: The Forecaster
tools.line: Train a holographic transformer live on a real hourly price tape and watch its next-move accuracy climb.

tools.name: Prism
tools.line: Chat with a small language model that runs entirely in your browser, and look under the hood at every layer it passes through.

tools.name: Nano Stories
tools.line: The same model as Prism, asked to write a story instead of hold a conversation. Give it an opening line and watch it continue.

tools.name: The Cartographer
tools.line: A map of one next-word decision: the path the model's representation takes through idea-space, decoded live from a single forward pass.

tools.name: Prose
tools.line: Paste in a body of text, mine its grammar in your browser, and recombine it into sentences and question and answer pairs for a training corpus.

tools.name: Council Spending Scanner
tools.line: English councils' published spending data, prepared ahead of time and opened one month at a time, with the same mechanical checks for every council.
